name: Implementation
description: One-session execution contract for work derived from one or more source Issues
title: impl:

sections.label: Repository identity
sections.description: JSON object containing repositoryHost, repositoryId, and optional owner/name repository locator

sections.label: Source Issues
sections.description: One canonical IssueReference JSON object per line

sections.label: Objective
sections.description: The concrete outcome for this one implementation session

sections.label: Non-goals
sections.description: Explicit boundaries; use one item per line

sections.label: Architecture decision
sections.description: The implementation design selected for this contract

sections.label: Affected components
sections.description: Semantic components or roles affected; one item per line when applicable

sections.label: Invariants
sections.description: Behavioral and architectural truths that must remain true

sections.label: Compatibility constraints
sections.description: Compatibility, migration, security, or performance constraints when applicable

sections.label: READONLY scope
sections.description: Readable repository-relative paths or globs; one per line. This never grants WRITE.

sections.label: WRITE scope
sections.description: Explicit writable repository-relative paths or globs; one per line. Empty means no WRITE.

sections.label: CREATE scope
sections.description: Paths that may be created; never inferred from WRITE

sections.label: DELETE scope
sections.description: Paths that may be deleted; never inferred from WRITE

sections.label: DENY / exclusions
sections.description: Explicit exclusions; DENY always overrides broader allowlists

sections.label: Prohibited operations
sections.description: Operations outside the session contract; one per line

sections.label: Immutable areas
sections.description: Areas that must remain unchanged; one per line

sections.label: Prerequisites
sections.description: Dependencies or conditions required before implementation

sections.label: Acceptance criteria
sections.description: Verifiable outcomes; one item per line

sections.label: Targeted tests
sections.description: Tests to run or an explicit `none`; one item per line

sections.label: Required checks
sections.description: Repository checks required before completion or an explicit `none`

sections.label: Observable postconditions
sections.description: Observable state expected after implementation or an explicit `none`

sections.label: Base branch
sections.description: Branch from which the implementation is based

sections.label: Base revision
sections.description: Known base commit revision; leave empty when it cannot yet be known

sections.label: Base freshness
sections.description: Provider or workflow freshness input, when known

sections.label: Implementation branch
sections.description: Canonical branch identity when already decided

sections.label: Execution dependencies
sections.description: One canonical IssueReference JSON object per line when execution depends on other Issues
